text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly changed positions and even sold and later rebought the same stocks; before trading, I should have a clear thesis and avoid switching without new evidence.","Several sales locked in losses, while other trades also failed to protect the account; I should define risk limits and exit rules in advance rather than react to short-term moves.","My account has declined so far, but this short record alone cannot tell me whether my approach beats the market; I should track results over a longer horizon against an appropriate benchmark."]}
